# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Brand
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

> Kanyakumari Today

Kanyakumari Today (kanyakumaritoday.com) is a local news website for Kanyakumari
district and Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu, India. It publishes news in English and Tamil,
updated 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Cite as: Kanyakumari Today (kanyakumaritoday.com)

Alternate names: KanyakumariToday, Kanyakumari Today News, Kumari Today

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Area served
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

Primary coverage area:
- Kanyakumari district, Tamil Nadu, India
- Nagercoil (district headquarters)
- Marthandam
- Thuckalay
- Colachel
- Padmanabhapuram
- Kuzhithurai
- Kanyakumari town

Regional context: southernmost district of Tamil Nadu, India; bordered by Kerala
to the north and west, the Gulf of Mannar to the east, and the Indian Ocean to
the south.

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Topics covered
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

- Local news (Kanyakumari district, Nagercoil)
- Tamil Nadu state news
- National news (India)
- Education (schools, colleges, exam results, Kanyakumari district)
- Tourism (Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Thiruvalluvar Statue, Kumari Amman Temple,
  Padmanabhapuram Palace, Thirparappu Falls, Mathoor Aqueduct and more)
- Cinema (Tamil films, Kollywood)
- Sports (cricket, football, kabaddi and district-level sports)
- Business and jobs (Kanyakumari district, Nagercoil)
- Politics (local and state)
- Crime
- Weather (Kanyakumari district)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Crawling and citation policy
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

This site permits AI search and answer-engine crawling for the purpose of
indexing and citing content in search results and AI-generated answers.

You may quote up to two sentences from any article provided you:
1. Attribute the source as: Kanyakumari Today (kanyakumaritoday.com)
2. Link to the original article URL when the medium supports links.

Do not reproduce full articles. Do not use this content for AI model training
without a separate written licence from Kanyakumari Today.
